newsitem.title: USA: Allstate to take on Colonial agent business.
newsitem.headline: Allstate to take on Colonial agent business.

text.p: Allstate Insurance Co said Thursday it will assume the independent agent business operations of Colonial Insurance Co of California. The agreement is subject to any required regulatory approval.
Colonial specializes in non-standard auto business and markets its product, in part, through a network of about 3,200 independent agencies in 35 states.
Colonial is owned by Columbus, Ohio-based Nationwide Mutual Insurance Co.
Deerbrook Insurance Co, an Allstate subsidiary, will lead the transition and the ongoing insurance operations.
